title: Problem Solving: Word Problems to 999
seo_title: Grade 3 Word Problems Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Solve word problems in context and explain own solution to problems involving addition and subtraction with answers up to 999.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 3 maths worksheets: word problems that add, take away and compare, missing numbers and two-step stories to 999. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Read the story twice and underline the question.
  • Altogether, more: add. Left, gave away: take away. How many more: find the difference.
  • A two-step story needs two number sentences.
  • Estimate first, then check your answer.

Examples

Example

A school has 345 boys and 382 girls

345 + 382

Answer: 727 learners

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
The wrong operationLeft means take away.
One stepDo both steps.
Copying a numberWork it out.

faq.a: Grade R to Grade 3 in South African schools. Grade 3 is the last year; learners are about 8 to 9 years old.
